DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昨日のお話について、追加のご連絡でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us with additional information about what you told us yesterday?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日、目撃した人は赤い上着だったと話しましたが、帰宅して思い返すと、その色には自信がなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目撃した服の色への自信がなくなったと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Yesterday I said the person I saw was wearing a red jacket, but after going home and thinking back, I became less sure about the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are no longer sure about the color of the clothes you witnessed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しく何か思い出したのか、昨日の記憶に迷いが出たのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me whether you have remembered something new or have become uncertain about yesterday's recollection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい資料はありません。近くに赤い看板があったことを思い出し、上着の色と混ぜたかもしれないと感じています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤い看板との混同可能性と新資料なしを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have no new material. I remembered a red sign nearby, and feel I may have confused it with the jacket's color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the possible confusion with a red sign and the absence of new material. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最初にお話しいただいた日時と、対応した担当は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know when you first spoke to us and which staff member helped you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の午後三時ごろ、この窓口でした。担当の名前を控えてあります。色の部分を確かな話として残したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前回の時刻担当と不確かな色の訂正希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was at this counter around three yesterday afternoon. I wrote down the staff member's name. I do not want the color to remain on record as a certainty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the previous time and staff member, and request correction of the uncertain color. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ訂正の相談を取り次ぎます。ほかの部分にも変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will refer your correction request to the staff member. Has anything else changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩いて去った方向は覚えています。色の自信がないからといって、覚えている方向まで全部取り消すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 方向の記憶は保ち訂正の範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I remember the direction the person walked away. Being unsure about the color does not mean I intend to retract the direction I remember as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your recollection of the direction and clarify the scope of the correction. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変わった所と、今も覚えている所を分けて担当へお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain separately to the staff member what has changed and what you still remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当には、色は看板と混同した可能性があり不確か、歩いた方向は変わらない、と伝えます。私の推測で新しい色を付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新しい色を推測せず確実性を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will say the color is uncertain because I may have confused it with the sign, while the walking direction remains the same. I will not invent another color based on a guess.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish levels of certainty without guessing a new color. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。追加のお話を担当へつなぎます。ご連絡ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass your additional account to the staff member. Thank you for contacting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒についてお尋ねになりたいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about an envelope, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。住所は私の部屋ですが、宛名は知らない人です。部屋が同じなら開けてよいのか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所一致と宛名相違の封筒について相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The address is my apartment, but the addressee is someone I do not know. I wondered whether I could open it because the apartment is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about an envelope with your address but a different addressee. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 開けずにお持ちいただいたのですね。住所と宛名の相違を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You brought it without opening it. I will check the discrepancy between the address and addressee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ封はそのままです。前に住んでいた人かどうかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と前住人か不明な点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The seal is still intact. I do not know whether this is someone who lived there before me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unopened and you do not know whether the person is a former resident. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 推測だけで宛名を書き直したりせず、取扱いを担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than rewriting the addressee based on a guess, let us ask the person responsible how to handle it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の名前に直して、内容を確かめようとはしません。差出人に連絡する前に、ここで扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名を書き換えず窓口で扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not change it to my name and try to check the contents. Before contacting the sender, I want to ask here how it should be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask at the counter how to handle it without changing the addressee. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に取り次ぎます。いつ郵便受けに入っていたか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will refer you to the person responsible. Do you know when it was in your mailbox?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の帰宅時に見つけました。ほかの郵便と分けて、この封筒だけ持参しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発見時刻と他郵便からの分離を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found it when I got home yesterday. I separated it from my other mail and brought only this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain when you found it and that you separated it from the other mail. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過を担当へお伝えください。ここでは内容の確認はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person responsible what happened. We cannot check the contents here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内容は知らないままです。住所が同じ、名前は違う、昨日見つけたという三点を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容を知らないまま確認事実をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I still do not know the contents. I will explain these three facts: the address matches, the name differs, and I found it yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the confirmed facts while keeping the contents unknown. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、封筒をそのまま担当へお見せください。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the envelope to the person responsible as it is. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらのご相談でお待ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of consultation are you waiting for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手続きの相談です。二十番の札を持っていますが、画面では三十一番まで進んでいて不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待ち番号が画面に追い越されたと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is about a procedure. My ticket is number twenty, but the screen has reached thirty-one, so I am worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your waiting number appearing to have been passed on the screen. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは列が手続き別に分かれています。お札の見出しを見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Our queues are divided by procedure. Please show me the heading on your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「相談」と書いてあります。画面の三十一番は「入出金」でした。番号だけを見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談札と入出金表示の違いに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “Consultation.” Number thirty-one on the screen was under “Deposits and withdrawals.” I was only looking at the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice the difference between your consultation ticket and the deposits-and-withdrawals display. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談の表示は右側です。今は十八番をお呼びしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The consultation display is on the right. We are currently calling number eighteen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、まだ私の順番は来ていないのですね。入出金の列に並び直す必要もありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談の順番未到来と並び直し不要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So my turn has not come yet. I do not need to join the deposits-and-withdrawals queue again either, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that your consultation turn has not arrived and you do not need to queue again. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その札でお待ちください。受付した相談内容は変わっていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please wait with that ticket. Has the consultation you registered for changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 口座の手続き相談のままです。現金を引き出す依頼ではないので、この列で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談内容は入出金でないと区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is still about an account procedure. I am not requesting a cash withdrawal, so I will wait in this queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your consultation from deposits and withdrawals. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 順番が来たら、お札と窓口の番号を照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When your turn comes, match your ticket with the counter number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 右側の相談表示を見ます。番号の大きさだけでなく、見出しと窓口も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示見出しと窓口を照合して待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will watch the consultation display on the right. I will check the heading and counter as well as the number itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait while matching the display heading and counter. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まもなくご案内しますので、こちらでお待ちください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will assist you shortly, so please wait here. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 総菜のご予約を受け取りにいらっしゃいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come to collect your prepared-food reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。棚に同じ料理があるので、一つ取って会計すれば予約を受け取ったことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の商品で予約受取りになるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The same dish is on the shelf, so if I take one and pay, does that count as collecting my reservation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether taking a shelf item counts as collecting your reservation. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約分は別に取り置いてあります。お名前と予約した数を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We keep reserved portions separately. Please let me confirm your name and the quantity you reserved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この名前で二つです。棚の一つはまだかごに入れず、札を見ただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約名数量と棚の商品未取得を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two under this name. I have not put the one from the shelf in my basket; I only looked at its label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name and quantity and explain that you have not taken the shelf item. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの予約を確認できました。受取り口からお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have confirmed your reservation for two. I will bring them from the pickup area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 棚の商品まで取ると三つになってしまいますね。予約した二つだけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約二つだけを受け取ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I also took the shelf item, that would make three. Please give me only the two I reserved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to collect only the two reserved portions. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しする際に、容器の名前と数量もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: When I hand them over, please also check the names on the containers and the quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つありますが、片方は違う料理の札です。私の予約は同じ料理を二つでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取容器の料理札が一つ違うと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There are two, but one is labeled as a different dish. I reserved two of the same dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out that one pickup container has the wrong dish label. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申し訳ありません。違う札の容器を戻し、予約内容と照合して入れ替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I am sorry. I will take back the container with the different label and replace it after checking the reservation details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入れ替え後の二つを確認します。棚から追加はしません。予約票と同じ料理になったら会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入替え後に予約票を照合して会計する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check both after the replacement. I will not add anything from the shelf. Once the dishes match my reservation slip, I will pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check against the reservation slip after replacement and then pay. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待たせしました。こちらの二つです。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for waiting. Here are the two portions. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 写生会へ参加される方ですね。道具はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are joining the outdoor sketching event, correct? Do you have your materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水彩の道具を持ってきました。筆を洗った水は、公園の水飲み場へ流せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水彩の使用水を水飲み場へ流せるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought watercolor materials. Can I pour the water used to wash my brushes into the park's drinking fountain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether used watercolor water can go into the drinking fountain. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の会では、使用した水は回収容器へ集めます。水飲み場では洗いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this event, we collect used water in a collection container. Please do not wash brushes at the drinking fountain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知りませんでした。持ってきた小さなバケツに水をためて、最後に回収へ持っていくのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: バケツへため回収する方法を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not know. So I should keep the water in the small bucket I brought and take it to the collection point at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand how to retain the water in your bucket and have it collected. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。人が歩く所へ置かず、席の横で使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Use it beside your seat, rather than placing it where people walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 椅子の横へ置きます。途中で水を替えたい場合も、いったん回収容器へ運べばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中の水交換時の回収を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put it beside my chair. If I want to change the water partway through, should I take it to the collection container first too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm collection when changing water during the event. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。回収場所は受付の裏です。容器を倒さないように運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Exactly. The collection point is behind reception. Carry it carefully so the container does not tip over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 色の付いた水を花壇へ捨てるのもやめます。運ぶ時は筆とバケツを別々に持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花壇へ捨てず別々に運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not pour the colored water into the flowerbeds either. When carrying things, I will carry my brushes and bucket separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid the flowerbeds and carry the items separately. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終了前に回収を済ませてください。残った絵の具は各自の道具と一緒に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please have the water collected before the event ends. Take any remaining paint home with your own materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終わる少し前に片付けます。絵だけでなく、残りの絵の具と空のバケツも持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了前の回収と道具持帰りを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tidy up shortly before the end. I will take home not only my painting but also the leftover paint and empty bucket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to have the water collected before the end and take your materials home. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お席へどうぞ。描く時間を楽しんでください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your seat. Enjoy your time painting. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合せの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a meeting place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人にはいつもの東口で会うと伝えましたが、今日は目の前に臨時改札があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 臨時改札がある日に東口待合せを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told my friend we would meet at the usual east exit, but today there is a temporary ticket gate right in front of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about meeting at the east exit when a temporary gate is open. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は催しのために臨時改札を開けています。いつもの東口とは別の場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have opened a temporary gate for today's event. It is in a different location from the usual east exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 臨時改札から出たら東口の前だと思っていました。友人は通常の東口へ来ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 臨時改札と通常出口を混同したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought that leaving through the temporary gate would put me in front of the east exit. My friend has come to the regular east exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused the temporary gate with the regular exit. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図で位置を比べましょう。通常の東口へ回ると少し遠くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us compare the locations on the map. Going around to the regular east exit is a little farther.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人に、臨時改札と東口は別だと伝えます。二人が互いに歩き始めるとすれ違いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 双方移動によるすれ違いを避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell my friend the temporary gate and east exit are different. If we both start walking toward each other, we might miss each other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to avoid missing each other by both moving. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらかが動かず待つ場所を決めておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to decide on a place where one of you will stay and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には東口で待ってもらい、私が図の道を通って向かいます。臨時改札の前には呼びません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人固定自分移動の待合せ方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have my friend wait at the east exit and go there myself along the route on the map. I will not ask them to come to the temporary gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a plan where your friend stays and you move. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、今いる場所から東口までの道を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the route from your present location to the east exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この連絡通路を通るのですね。移動するのは私だけと連絡し、東口の看板を見てから合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道と連絡内容を確認して合流する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I go through this connecting passage, correct? I will tell my friend only I am moving, and meet up after checking the east-exit sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the route and message, then meet your friend. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 道順はそのとおりです。それでは、ご友人とのお出かけをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That is the right route. Enjoy your outing with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面の表示についてご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about what the screen shows?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 市の講座の申込みを入力し、「保存しました」と出ました。これで受付が終わったと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 下書き保存を受付完了と混同したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I entered an application for a city course, and it said “Saved.” I thought that meant the application had been received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you confused saving a draft with completing submission. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示は下書きの保存ですね。送信後に出る受付の表示とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That message refers to saving a draft. It differs from the confirmation shown after submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面を閉じる前に気づけてよかったです。まだ連絡先に古い電話番号が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古い連絡番号が残っていると気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am glad I noticed before closing the screen. My old telephone number is still in the contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice that an old contact number remains. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力内容を見直してください。こちらではご本人の代わりに送信はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please review your entries. We will not submit it on your behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で今の番号に直します。日程を家族に確かめていないので、今日は送信せずに残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号修正と家族確認のため送信を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will change it to my current number myself. I have not checked the dates with my family, so I want to leave it without submitting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the number and postpone submission until checking with your family. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場合は下書きの扱いと申込期限を画面の案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, check the onscreen instructions about drafts and the application deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 下書きのままでも席が取れているわけではないのですね。期限までに家族と相談して送信します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 下書きは席の確保でないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So keeping a draft does not mean a place is reserved. I will discuss it with my family and submit before the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that a draft does not reserve a place. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。申込みが完了したら、受付の表示を控えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. When you complete the application, keep a record of the receipt confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存の表示を受付の証拠にはしません。番号と日程を確かめた後、送信結果を別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送信後の受付表示を別に控えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not treat the saved message as proof of receipt. After checking the number and dates, I will separately check the submission result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separately retain the receipt confirmation after submission. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不明な表示は送信前にまたお尋ねください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask again about any unclear messages before submitting. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お呼びした方は、こちらへお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: If your name was called, please come this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と同じ名字が聞こえましたが、受付票の番号は違うようです。ついて行く前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同姓の呼出しと番号相違を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the same surname as mine, but the number seems different from my reception slip. I want to check before following.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm a call using your surname but a different number. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お手元の番号を教えてください。ここでは名字だけでなく番号も照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your number. Here we match the number as well as the surname.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四十二番です。今聞こえたのは二十四番だったかもしれません。音だけでは自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の番号と聞取りの不確かさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is forty-two. The number I just heard may have been twenty-four. I am not sure from the sound alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your own number and explain your uncertainty about what you heard. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今お呼びしたのは二十四番です。四十二番の方のご案内はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We just called twenty-four. We have not yet called forty-two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の方でしたね。前に立っていたので自分だと思いました。席へ戻って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別人と分かり席で待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was someone else. I thought it was me because I was standing in front. I will return to my seat and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait in your seat after realizing it was another person. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号の表示は、座っている所から見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you see the number display from where you are sitting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 柱で半分隠れています。名字が聞こえた時に番号も確かめられる席へ移りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号表示の見える席へ移動を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Half of it is hidden by a pillar. I would like to move to a seat where I can also check the number when I hear my surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to move to a seat with a clear view of the number display. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの席なら表示が見えます。通路側は空けてお座りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see the display from this seat. Please sit without blocking the aisle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここから四十二番を確認して待ちます。呼ばれた名字が同じでも、番号を確かめてから進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名字と番号を照合してから進むと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here and watch for forty-two. Even if the surname called is mine, I will check the number before going forward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to match the surname and number before proceeding. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認してくださってありがとうございます。それでは、順番までお待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please wait until your turn. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見聞きしたことを順番にお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me what you saw and heard in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道路の方から大きな音がしました。七時十六分に時計を見ましたが、音がした時刻とは少し違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 音の時刻と時計を見た時刻が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard a loud noise from the road. I looked at the clock at seven sixteen, but that is slightly different from when the noise occurred.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the noise and your look at the clock happened at different times. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音がしてから時計を見るまで、何をしていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you do between hearing the noise and looking at the clock?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 台所で音を聞き、窓へ行って外を見てから時計を見ました。何分かかったかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音後の行動と経過時間不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard it in the kitchen, went to the window, looked outside, and then checked the clock. I do not know how many minutes that took.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe your actions after the noise and the unknown elapsed time. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 十六分というのは時計を見た時刻として記録します。外で何が見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record sixteen minutes past as the time you looked at the clock. What did you see outside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 止まった車は見えましたが、衝突した瞬間は見ていません。音から事故だと考えたのは私の推測です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 衝突目撃なしと事故という推測を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw a stopped car, but I did not see the moment of impact. Thinking it was an accident because of the noise was my own inference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate not witnessing a collision from inferring an accident. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見たことと推測を分けて教えてくださって結構です。車の特徴は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is helpful to distinguish what you saw from your guesses. Do you remember the car's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 白っぽい車でした。ただ、暗かったので白だと言い切れません。台所からは車そのものは見えませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車の色を断定せず観察範囲を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It looked whitish. But it was dark, so I cannot say definitely that it was white. I could not see the car itself from the kitchen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid certainty about the color and explain the limits of your view. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない所は分からないままでお話しください。写真などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave unknown details as unknown when you tell us. Do you have photographs or anything similar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮っていません。音、窓から見た車、時計を見た順序は説明できますが、正確な発生時刻は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真なしと分かる順序をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I did not take any. I can explain the sequence of the noise, the car seen from the window, and checking the clock, but I do not know the exact time it happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the known sequence and the absence of photographs. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別で伺います。お話しいただきありがとうございました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your account with that distinction. Thank you for telling us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の準備でお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble preparing an envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。切手を貼るつもりの場所まで宛名を書いてしまいました。上から切手を貼って隠してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手予定位置に書いた宛名を隠してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote the addressee's name into the space where I intended to put the stamp. May I stick the stamp over it and cover it up?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may cover addressee writing in the intended stamp position. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名が読めなくなるので、そのまま隠さないでください。別の封筒はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not simply cover it, as the addressee would become unreadable. Do you have another envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう一枚あります。まだ封をしていないので、中身を新しい封筒へ移せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封緘で予備封筒に移せると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have one more. I have not sealed this one yet, so I can move the contents into the new envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unsealed and you can use a spare envelope. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい封筒に書く際は、切手の場所と宛名の場所を分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: When writing on the new envelope, keep the stamp area separate from the addressee area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に切手の場所を空けて、中央に宛名を書きます。この見本の縦書きでなく横書きでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切手場所を空け横書き見本を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will first leave space for the stamp and write the addressee in the center. May I write horizontally rather than vertically like this example?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave stamp space and ask for a horizontal-writing example. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの横長の封筒に合う見本をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will show you an example suited to your wide envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横書きの見本をお願いします。古い封筒の住所を写すだけでなく、送付先の案内とも照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本と送付先の案内を照合すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please show me the horizontal example. I will not just copy the old envelope's address; I will also compare it with the destination instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the example with the destination instructions. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した後、差出人も忘れずに書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After rewriting it, do not forget to add the sender as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい封筒の表と裏を書き終えました。切手が名前を隠さない位置を最後に見て、封をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表裏を仕上げ切手位置確認後に封緘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished writing the front and back of the new envelope. I will finally check that the stamp does not cover the name, then seal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Finish both sides, check the stamp position, and seal the envelope. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛名は読めています。それでは、差出しの窓口へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-24207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: The addressee is readable. Please proceed to the posting counter. Goodbye.
